spec.description: Provider operations for Nais Postgres (CNPG): observed primaries, replication, Barman backups, WAL and storage. One tenant at a time; not an end-to-end availability or restore guarantee.

options.content:
**Provider view · one tenant at a time.** Select a `*-metrics` datasource (Mimir, `nais` org). The fleet table includes every **currently discovered scrape target**, including failed scrapes. `Unknown` is not healthy.

**Not a complete inventory:** databases stuck before a target exists, and branches whose targets have all disappeared, are not visible. Branch activation, desired replica count, pooler/connectivity and actual SQL read/write are not measured here. Check Console/events for provisioning. No new alerts are created by this dashboard.

**Backups:** use Barman-plugin metrics, not CNPG's legacy backup timestamps. Backup age >36h needs investigation; it is not an RPO promise. WAL archive age alone can be high on an idle database. Recovery metadata does not prove a continuous archive or a tested restore.

panels.description: Actual streaming connections. Desired replica count is not exported here; one connection does not prove the configured HA topology is satisfied.

panels.title: Streaming replicas at primary

panels.description: Maximum observed replica lag per branch. Missing replicas produce missing data, not zero lag.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (cnpg_pg_replication_lag{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"} and on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Replica replay lag

panels.description: Targets without cnpg_collector_up. Healthy branches have no matching series in this panel; consult the fleet table for explicit counts.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})) unless on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (cnpg_collector_up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})) or (0 * group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}))) > 0

panels.title: Missing SQL telemetry / discovered targets
Backups and WAL — investigate unknowns; verify recovery with restore drills

panels.description: Barman-plugin timestamp; -1 means no positive timestamp reported. Daily backups: >36h is a triage hint, not an agreed SLO.

targets.expr: ((time() - (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}) > 0)) or (-1 * group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}))))

panels.title: Age of latest available basebackup

panels.description: Barman archive metadata, not a proof of WAL continuity. Missing/zero timestamps are omitted; do not infer a 30-day restore guarantee.

targets.expr: (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_first_recoverability_point{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}) > 0) * 1000

panels.title: First recoverability point (reported)

panels.description: Maximum ready-to-archive files on any observed pod in a branch. Persistent or growing backlog warrants investigation.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (cnpg_collector_pg_wal_archive_status{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}", value="ready"})

panels.title: WAL files waiting for archive

panels.description: Increase in failed archive attempts over $__rate_interval. Retries can occur; inspect backlog and successful progress together.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (increase(cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: WAL archive failures

panels.description: Informational only. Idle databases may not generate new WAL; age alone is not an archive-stalled alarm. Only positive archive timestamps are shown.

targets.expr: time() - (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_last_archived_time{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}) > 0)

panels.title: Time since last successful WAL archive

panels.description: Historical failures can remain after a successful backup. Compare with latest available backup; an empty table is not proof of working backups.

targets.expr: (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_failed_backup_timestamp{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"}) > 0) * 1000

panels.title: Last failed backup (reported)
Capacity — worst observed pod per branch

panels.description: Highest pgdata filesystem usage per branch, joined via the pod/PVC relationship. Uses actual filesystem capacity, not requested disk size.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) ((100 * max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) / on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"})) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_right() max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{volume="pgdata", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group_left(team, postgres, branch) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})))

panels.title: Data volume used

panels.description: Lowest available pgdata filesystem space per branch. Missing kubelet/PVC metrics are unknown, not zero usage.

targets.expr: min by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) ((max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"})) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_right() max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{volume="pgdata", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group_left(team, postgres, branch) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})))

panels.title: Least free data volume space

panels.description: Highest container working set / positive memory limit per branch. No limit or missing metrics yields no observation; this does not diagnose memory pressure by itself.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) ((max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="postgres", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) / on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="postgres", resource="memory", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"} > 0)) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group_left(team, postgres, branch) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})) * 100)

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="postgres", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__range])) * on (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, pod) group_left(team, postgres, branch) group by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (max by (k8s_cluster_name, namespace, team, postgres, branch, pod) (up{postgres!="", k8s_cluster_name=~"${environment:regex}", team=~"${team:regex}", postgres=~"${postgres:regex}", branch=~"${branch:regex}"})))
